usage: policy should match build artifacts from artifactory
name: Artifactory image should reference build artifact
description: A file found in your artifactory was not matched to an an artifact from your build system via hash or name.
detailedDescription: An image name in your artifactory not matched to a build artifact may indicate an attempt to compromise the cloud account. An unauthorized application may be running in your organization's cloud. A crypto miner is an example of this.
